clue.text: Volunteers, Europeans, housing five hundred little creatures

indicators.note: housing means the first pieces hold another piece inside them

parts.note: TA is the Territorial Army, Britain's volunteer reserve
Poles are people from Poland, Europeans
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred

explanation.surface: A parade of volunteer soldiers and Europeans sheltering a crowd of tiny animals.
explanation.definitionFit: Young frogs and toads in their larval stage are small aquatic animals, so tiny beasts fits.

clue.text: 11, most importantly

definitions.meaning: the clue 11 across, meaning better than all others, unbeatable
a phrase meaning chiefly, before everything else

explanation.surface: A cross-reference followed by a phrase of emphasis.
explanation.definitionFit: Both senses are idioms for supreme priority: being unbeatable, and chiefly or first of all.

clue.text: Bet sin could be destroyed with prayer for this worshipper

indicators.note: destroyed letters are broken up and reassembled, so the words get rearranged

explanation.surface: A devout person hopes prayer will wipe out the sin of gambling.
explanation.definitionFit: A member of a Calvinist church governed by elders is a kind of churchgoer who worships.

clue.text: Operator's instrument in window

definitions.meaning: a surgeon, who operates, uses a small pointed knife
a tall narrow window with a pointed arch, as in Gothic churches

explanation.surface: A surgical tool found in a window, as if left on the sill.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a surgeon's double-edged blade and a narrow pointed-arch window in architecture.

clue.text: PR stuff is what a twister provides

definitions.meaning: public relations people put a favourable slant on news

explanation.surface: Public relations material likened to the work of a twister, a cheat.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a biased presentation of news and rotational motion such as a whirlwind gives.

clue.text: A student in trouble? It's not made explicit

indicators.note: letters in trouble are disturbed, so they get rearranged

explanation.surface: A student gets into trouble, but nobody says so openly.
explanation.definitionFit: Something left unsaid or only implied has not been spelled out clearly.

clue.text: Distant circle in gambling game

parts.note: distant means far away
the letter O is round, like a circle

explanation.surface: A faraway ring of players in a game of chance.
explanation.definitionFit: This is an old card game in which players bet on the order cards are dealt.

clue.text: Ben and mates mingling in garden flat?

indicators.note: mingling mixes the letters together into a new order

explanation.surface: Ben and his friends mixing at a party in a ground-floor flat.
explanation.definitionFit: A garden flat is an estate agent's term for a below-ground or lower-ground apartment opening onto a garden.

clue.text: Picture of central American country in which gold is found

indicators.note: in which ... is found places one piece inside the country

parts.note: Panama is a country in Central America
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A painting of a Central American land where gold has been discovered.
explanation.definitionFit: A wide unbroken view of a whole scene is a sweeping picture.

clue.text: Coastal location offering Beethoven's Fifth, Sixth, Seventh, and Eighth

indicators.note: the ordinals name the letter positions to take from the composer's name

explanation.surface: A seaside town plays Beethoven symphonies five to eight, like a festival programme.
explanation.walkthrough: The numbers look like symphonies but pick letters five to eight of BEETHOVEN. Hove is a seaside town on the Sussex coast beside Brighton.
explanation.definitionFit: The town sits on England's south coast, so it is a seaside place.

clue.text: Support not about to be given by individual better than the rest

parts.note: to second a motion is to support it

indicators.note: about tells us the word not is turned round

parts.note: one means a single individual

explanation.surface: Backing withheld from a person who outshines everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Being unsurpassed by anyone means being the best of all.

clue.text: No set dinners arranged for hotel visitors not staying the night?

definitions.text: hotel visitors not staying the night

indicators.note: arranged means the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: A hotel provides no set meals for guests who leave before bedtime.
explanation.definitionFit: People who use a hotel's bar or restaurant without lodging there are guests not living in.

clue.text: Arty cad, I fancy, getting female made of stone for support

definitions.text: female made of stone for support

indicators.note: fancy as a verb means imagine, signalling the letters are reworked

explanation.surface: An arty cad fancies himself with a stone woman, a statue used as a prop.
explanation.definitionFit: In classical architecture a column carved as a draped woman holds up an entablature.

clue.text: Sink has very little liquid? There's nothing in it

indicators.note: in it places one piece inside the liquid piece

parts.note: a drop is a tiny amount of liquid
O looks like zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A sink holding barely any water appears empty.
explanation.definitionFit: To sag or hang down limply is to sink downwards.

clue.text: Perplexity? Time to get perspective

parts.note: an angle is a point of view, a perspective

explanation.surface: When confused, it is time to step back and gain a view.
explanation.definitionFit: A confused muddle or state of bewilderment is a complicated mess of the mind.

clue.text: In Home Counties, see type of fruit

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the region piece

parts.note: SE is South East England, where the Home Counties surrounding London lie
lo is an old word meaning look or see

explanation.surface: Visiting the counties around London, look at a kind of fruit.
explanation.definitionFit: This small blue-black wild plum from blackthorn is used in flavouring gin.

clue.text: Boxes, see, not in close-packed configuration

parts.note: spars means boxes in the sense of sparring
a see is a bishop's diocese; Ely is a cathedral city in Cambridgeshire

explanation.surface: Packing boxes, look, not stacked tightly together.
explanation.definitionFit: Spread thinly with gaps between means not densely arranged.

clue.text: Type of thoroughfare and what it probably isn't

definitions.meaning: a ... is a British secondary road, below an A road
such minor roads are usually narrow, not wide

explanation.surface: A kind of road, and a quality it most likely lacks.
explanation.walkthrough: In Britain, B roads are minor routes, often narrow country lanes, so read as one word the answer describes what they seldom are.
explanation.definitionFit: The letter label for a minor road also spells a word meaning wide, which such lanes usually are not.

clue.text: Risky enterprise — two chaps duped

parts.note: a bet is a risky venture, a gamble
Ray and Ed are two men's names

explanation.surface: Two men, after a risky venture, find they have been cheated.
explanation.definitionFit: Being let down or deceived by someone trusted is being tricked.

clue.text: Regular occupants of eery site at one time

indicators.note: regular occupants are letters at every other place in the words

explanation.surface: Regular tenants of a spooky site from long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic adverb meaning formerly or once, still seen in erstwhile.

clue.text: Sort of mixture is what you are looking for

definitions.meaning: a liquid in which a substance is dissolved
the solver seeks the answer to the clue

explanation.surface: A chemist's mixture and the thing the solver hunts.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a dissolved liquid mixture and the answer to a puzzle.

clue.text: Characters stuck in class — is teacher giving help?

indicators.note: the characters are lodged within the run of words

explanation.surface: Pupils stuck in class wonder if the teacher will lend a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To aid or support someone is to lend them a hand.

clue.text: Friend left as one disinclined to work and showing no vitality

parts.note: pal means friend
idly means lazily, like someone avoiding work

explanation.surface: A friend leaves like a lazy person, looking listless.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something wanly, pale and lifeless, means without energy or vigour.

clue.text: One in group with hesitation gets to hang around

indicators.note: in places one piece inside the group piece

parts.note: a lot is a set or group
I is the Roman numeral one
er is the sound of a hesitating speaker

explanation.surface: A hesitant member of a group ends up lingering.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger idly in a place is to dawdle about.

clue.text: System accounting for the enemy in a locality

definitions.text: System accounting for the enemy in a locality

parts.words: System accounting for the enemy in a locality
parts.note: the enemy is time, as in the old enemy; a regional system for telling it

explanation.surface: A military scheme for counting foes in a district.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The enemy' is a stock phrase for time, the foe that runs out on us.
explanation.definitionFit: A uniform clock time adopted throughout a region is a scheme of reckoning hours locally.

clue.text: Soon to be deprived of love, a woman

indicators.note: deprived of means a piece is taken away from the word

parts.note: anon is an old word for soon
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A woman soon to lose her love.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a girl's name, so any woman bearing it.

clue.text: Soft slime heaped up in rubbish tip?

indicators.note: in a down clue, heaped up means the pieces are stacked upward, read backwards

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for soft
mud is slimy wet earth

explanation.surface: Soft slime piled up at a refuse tip.
explanation.definitionFit: A place where refuse is dumped, a tip, is a synonym for a rubbish site.

clue.text: Green enthusiast set about protecting island

indicators.note: protecting means one piece is held inside another
set about means the whole construction is turned round

parts.note: a fan is an enthusiast

explanation.surface: An environmental campaigner sets about defending an island.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Green' suggests the environment, but means inexperienced. 'protecting' puts I inside FAN, making FIAN, and 'set about' turns that round.
explanation.definitionFit: Naive or inexperienced people are innocent, as green as a novice.

clue.text: Lion in trouble with awkward mule — such may be on the floor

definitions.text: such may be on the floor

indicators.note: in trouble means the first word's letters are disturbed
awkward means the second word's letters are also jumbled

explanation.surface: A troubled lion and a stubborn mule sprawl on the ground.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' rearranges LION into LINO and 'awkward' rearranges MULE into LEUM.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a hard-wearing smooth floor covering, so it lies underfoot.

clue.text: Looking at country, celebrate

parts.note: Peru is a South American country
to sing is to celebrate in song

explanation.surface: Viewing a country and breaking into joyful song.
explanation.definitionFit: Reading something carefully means examining it closely.
